planning_notes: Wiring is D2 button input and D13 LED output; no other pins were supplied or authorized.
The application-level mode logic (blink/steady/off cadence and transitions) is implemented in SysML, not in device requests.
Button model value is true when pressed; active_high=true and pullup=true are assumed so an unpressed switch reads LOW.
Control period (scheduling granularity) set to 5 ms; actual blink timing is determined in SysML using elapsed_ms.
